name: Amber
source:
Amber is a student at Sweet Amoris that will become a traditional bully to heroine along with Li and Charlotte. Amber is the twin sister of Nathaniel.

Likes: Castiel, fashion, being pleased and in the spotlight
Dislikes: spiders, heroine, Deborah, that someone steps on her toes
